article_sentences: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay has claimed ownership over 50 cents of government poromboke land at Vilpatti village in Kodaikanal, falsely declared a property sold by him for ₹35 crore at Padi in Chennai as his property worth ₹7 crore and wrongly termed his Neelangarai bungalow as inherited property, an election petitioner has claimed before the Madras High Court.
However, Mr Vijay said the allegations against him were baseless and the petition must be dismissed.

stories.headline: Supreme Court terms vehicular emissions major contributor to air pollution in Delhi-NCR
stories.title: Supreme Court terms vehicular emissions major contributor to air pollution in Delhi-NCR
stories.summary: The Bench highlighted the large number of vehicles plying on roads connecting Delhi with neighbouring areas, including Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, Gurugram and Faridabad
reasons: source: event has 2 copies, primary source counted once
corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
event term: 'supreme court' in title weight 44
article_sentences: The Supreme Court on Friday (November 6, 2026) termed vehicular emissions a major contributor to air pollution in Delhi-NCR and said immediate, medium- and long-term measures were needed to curb the rising air quality index.

Hearing a suo motu case examining the regulatory framework governing air pollution, a Bench comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana also expressed concern over “bumper-to-bumper” traffic in Delhi-NCR.
“We keep talking and sometimes make statements and suggestions, but the point is that AQI is already touching 400,” the CJI said.
The Bench highlighted the large number of vehicles plying on roads connecting Delhi with neighbouring areas, including Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, Gurugram and Faridabad.
“Look at the roads in Delhi and the roads connecting Delhi with the NCR.
Take a look at any road and the kind of vehicles moving on it.
That is the major problem,” the CJI said.
The Bench said the poor people are the real sufferers, as they are on the roads, and moreover, the festival time is the only period when they earn a livelihood.
On stubble burning, the Bench stressed the need to educate farmers about using machines instead of resorting to farm fires.

On the plea seeking closure of schools or running them in hybrid mode for students of all age groups if the air quality index (AQI) rises above a certain mark, the bench said it will go by experts’ opinion.

Additional Solicitor General Aishwarya Bhati, appearing for the Centre and other authorities, referred to the regulatory framework covering five major sectors: industrial emissions, vehicular pollution, construction and demolition dust, road dust and stubble burning.

She told the Bench that several measures had been introduced, including restrictions on the entry of certain vehicles, geo-tagging of pollution under control (PUC) certificates and action against visibly polluting vehicles through complaints received on applications and social media.

The reports have prompted the company to launch an investigation.Nvidia shares dropped to $178 apiece overnight. This came after Huang in a message to company employees released on Sunday acknowledged having an affair and apologised to both his family and company staff. "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry,” the 63-year-old Taiwanese-born executive said."Leading Nvidia is the privilege of my life. My responsibility is to serve you and be worthy of your trust. I have fallen short of that responsibility,” he further wrote in the letter to employees obtained by The Associated Press.Also read | Nvidia probes CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: Here’s the lowdownWho is Alice Huang?Why the personal matter of the CEO may have spooked investors is because the person he has been intimate with is Alice Huang, who previously was a television reporter in China before becoming a top executive at Singapore-based data centre company Megaspeed, which has become one of Nvidia's biggest customers in Southeast Asia. The Times reported last month that US intelligence agencies had discovered that Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen and chip buyer, was feeding information directly to China."I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security,” Jensen Huang said. Nvidia meanwhile launched the investigation into reports that the CEO was the "target of a foreign intelligence effort.”Nvidia's board said it has "no reason to believe" that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, but that its inquiry would examine all available information. Huang "fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it," the board said. Tesla CEO Elon Musk reacted to Maguire's post with a brief endorsement, saying: "I agree."Billionaire Bill Ackman said Huang has done a lot of good for the world and he hopes the damage here is minimal. “That is, I am hoping for a simple affair, not a risk to our national security,” he said. “I am not suggesting he gets a free pass. If indeed this is more than an affair, then it is obviously a real problem.”What lies ahead for Nvidia shares?This boardroom storm at Nvidia has landed at a brutal time for the AI trade, but Nvidia's earnings on November 17 are the real next test, Reuters quoted Etoro lead analyst Josh Gilbert as saying. opening: Nvidia shares fell more than 4% in overnight trading on Monday after CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged having a close relationship with a business executive reportedly alleged by US intelligence to be a Chinese spy.
The reports have prompted the company to launch an investigation.
body: Nvidia shares dropped to $178 apiece overnight.
This came after Huang in a message to company employees released on Sunday acknowledged having an affair and apologised to both his family and company staff.
"I was unfaithful to my wife.
My actions hurt her and our children.
There is no excuse for what I did.
I am deeply sorry,” the 63-year-old Taiwanese-born executive said." Leading Nvidia is the privilege of my life.
My responsibility is to serve you and be worthy of your trust.
I have fallen short of that responsibility,” he further wrote in the letter to employees obtained by The Associated Press.
Also read | Nvidia probes CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: Here’s the lowdown.
Who is Alice Huang?

Why the personal matter of the CEO may have spooked investors is because the person he has been intimate with is Alice Huang, who previously was a television reporter in China before becoming a top executive at Singapore-based data centre company Megaspeed, which has become one of Nvidia's biggest customers in Southeast Asia.

The Times reported last month that US intelligence agencies had discovered that Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen and chip buyer, was feeding information directly to China." I love our country and our company.
I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security,” Jensen Huang said.

Nvidia meanwhile launched the investigation into reports that the CEO was the "target of a foreign intelligence effort.” Nvidia's board said it has "no reason to believe" that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, but that its inquiry would examine all available information.
Huang "fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it," the board said.
Huang will continue to hold the position of CEO during the investigation.
Also read | Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's secret affair: Why did US intelligence suspect Alice Huang of spying for China?
Donald Trump, Musk back Nvidia CEOUS President Donald Trump said he thinks Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is an honourable guy.
“I have not spoken to him about it.
I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what is going on.
I hope everything's fine,” he said.
Sequoia Capital partner Shaun Maguire described Huang as "one of the greatest entrepreneurs of this generation", while acknowledging that the Nvidia chief had made a serious mistake.

Tesla CEO Elon Musk reacted to Maguire's post with a brief endorsement, saying: "I agree." Billionaire Bill Ackman said Huang has done a lot of good for the world and he hopes the damage here is minimal.
“That is, I am hoping for a simple affair, not a risk to our national security,” he said.
“I am not suggesting he gets a free pass.
If indeed this is more than an affair, then it is obviously a real problem.” What lies ahead for Nvidia shares?
This boardroom storm at Nvidia has landed at a brutal time for the AI trade, but Nvidia's earnings on November 17 are the real next test, Reuters quoted Etoro lead analyst Josh Gilbert as saying.

While the investigation is likely to dent sentiment, it won't alter anything long-term unless it leads to a change at the top, at which point it becomes a completely different ball game, the analyst said.
Will Huang get replaced?
Pepperstone Head of Research Chris Weston doesn’t think so.
“I think given that he is like the godfather of AI and, you know, the OG of what has been the biggest investment thematic that we've seen in a generation,” Reuters quoted him as saying.
If things went south and Huang had to step down, then Nvidia shares may see an absolute bloodbath, according to the analyst.
